en: The separate diagnostic gave the following pool-specific results. C10k.0/981: 14/0/6 shorter/tied/longer in 20 valid seed pairs, mean +716.29 ppm and conditional seed bootstrap interval [+251.78, +1200.80] ppm. genC15k.seed100004/2521: 12/0/8 shorter/tied/longer in 20 valid seed pairs, mean -109.03 ppm and conditional seed bootstrap interval [-371.59, +139.14] ppm. genC15k.seed100004/1861: 8/0/12 shorter/tied/longer in 20 valid seed pairs, mean -219.79 ppm and conditional seed bootstrap interval [-664.72, +273.42] ppm.
zh: C10k.0/981 的 20 个有效种子对为 14/0/6 短/平/长，均值 +716.29 ppm，条件种子重抽样区间 [+251.78, +1200.80] ppm。genC15k.seed100004/2521 的 20 个有效种子对为 12/0/8 短/平/长，均值 -109.03 ppm，条件种子重抽样区间 [-371.59, +139.14] ppm。genC15k.seed100004/1861 的 20 个有效种子对为 8/0/12 短/平/长，均值 -219.79 ppm，条件种子重抽样区间 [-664.72, +273.42] ppm。
